## Details

<a id="scene_top_colour"></a>
### [`scene_top_colour`](../../../../src/data/fighter_constants.asm#L5) `$7F40-$7F41`

*data*

Background colour from raster line $72 to line $fa (the lower screen), one for each scene ($c4). Part 1: brown ($09) for both. Part 2: $0b.

- **Read by:** [`raster_irq`](../irq/irq_handler.md#raster_irq)

<a id="fighter_start_column"></a>
### [`fighter_start_column`](../../../../src/data/fighter_constants.asm#L7) `$7F42-$7F43`

*data*

Start column of each fighter ($71,x): 0 and $1f (2 bytes, one for each fighter).

- **Read by:** [`init_fighters`](../fighter/fighter_init.md#init_fighters), [`end_bout`](../combat/end_of_bout.md#end_bout)

<a id="fighter_home_column"></a>
### [`fighter_home_column`](../../../../src/data/fighter_constants.asm#L9) `$7F44-$7F45`

*data*

Column where a fighter stops when it walks back: 3 and $1c. Indexed by fighter or by facing.

- **Read by:** [`check_time_out`](../combat/time_out.md#check_time_out), [`end_bout`](../combat/end_of_bout.md#end_bout)

<a id="facing_sprite_offset"></a>
### [`facing_sprite_offset`](../../../../src/data/fighter_constants.asm#L11) `$7F46-$7F47`

*data*

Added to the sprite frame when the fighter faces left ($91,x = 1): 0 and $0d.

- **Read by:** [`set_fighter_sprite`](../sprites/fighter_sprites.md#set_fighter_sprite)

<a id="facing_step_mask"></a>
### [`facing_step_mask`](../../../../src/data/fighter_constants.asm#L13) `$7F48-$7F49`

*data*

EOR mask for the step bits of a frame record. $0c swaps the step direction when the fighter faces left.

- **Read by:** [`move_fighter`](../fighter/move.md#move_fighter)

<a id="turn_column_adjust"></a>
### [`turn_column_adjust`](../../../../src/data/fighter_constants.asm#L15) `$7F4A-$7F4B`

*data*

Added to the column of a fighter when it turns: +3 when it faces right, -3 when it faces left.

- **Read by:** [`animate_fighter`](../fighter/animate.md#animate_fighter)
